title: 第17章 王琳送饭第18章 被子划分三八线
content_zh:
“啊！”来人惊叫一声。
竟然是王琳。
叶开感到奇怪，大半夜的王琳怎么会过来，“你怎么来了？”
王琳笑嘻嘻地说：“我来看看你呀。”
叶开没好气地说：“有什么好看的，你姐夫病倒了需要人照顾，
你不照顾他，大晚上的跑来我家，简直胡闹！”
“有人照顾他，根本不需要我。”
叶开把灯打开，王琳穿着一件白衬衫配牛仔裤，显得清新靓丽，把圆硕的蜜桃臀和修长的腿勾勒得淋漓尽致。
看见叶开盯着她，王琳以为叶开被她的美貌所倾倒，颇为得意地挺了挺胸脯，那山峰顿时变得巍峨壮观。
“你还没吃饭吧，我给你带了些好吃的。”
王琳把一个塑料袋放在桌子上，解开后，一股香气扑鼻而来。
叶开还真感到饿了，就不客气了。
他取出一个盘子，把塑料袋里的菜倒进盘子里，
有红烧牛肉和排骨，都是硬菜，满满的一大盘，
“怎么样，好吃吧？我专门给你留的。”
“嗯，不错。”
叶开拿了双筷子，夹起一根排骨送进嘴里。
“别着急，我这还有好东西呢！”
王琳把手伸进白衬衫里面，鼓鼓囊囊的。
叶开赶紧摆手，“不要不要，你这是干什么？”

王琳嘻嘻一笑，把手从衬衫里拿出来，就像变魔术一样，掏出两个大馒头递给叶开，
“我知道你喜欢吃馒头，专门给你带了两个大馒头。”
叶开以手抚胸，“妈呀，你吓我一跳，我还以为是啥呢！原来是馒头，你也不用揣进衣服里啊！”
“我不是怕凉了不好吃嘛。”
叶开接过馒头，确实软绵绵、热乎乎的，
“谢谢你，你还真是有心人。”
“现在知道我的好了吧，赶紧趁热吃吧。”
叶开很快就把两个馒头一盘菜全部消灭了。
王琳就坐在对面看他吃，不时点头表示赞扬，小伙子这么能吃肯定也能干。
叶开吃完饭，站起来，“走，我送你回家吧。”
“不，我不回家。”
“你一个女孩子不回家怎么能行？”
“我想住在你家里。”
“不行，咱俩刚认识，孤男寡女的，怎么能住在一起。”
“我就要住这里，我看你家有两个卧室，咱俩一人一间。”
“你来我家，你姐知道吗？”
“她不知道。”
“你姐会不放心你的，说不定一会就来找你，你还是赶紧回去吧。”
content_en:
"Ah!" The visitor exclaimed.
It turned out to be Wang Lin.
Ye Kai felt strange why Wang Lin came here in the middle of the night, "Why are you here?"
Wang Lin said with a smile: "Let me see you."
Ye Kai said angrily: "What's there to see? Your brother-in-law is ill and needs someone to take care of him.
You don't take care of him, you come to my house at night, it's just nonsense! "
"There are people taking care of him and he doesn't need me at all."
Ye Kai turned on the light, and Wang Lin looked fresh and beautiful in a white shirt and jeans, which perfectly outlined her round peach buttocks and slender legs.
Seeing Ye Kai staring at her, Wang Lin thought that Ye Kai was overwhelmed by her beauty, so she proudly puffed up her chest, and the mountain peak suddenly became majestic and majestic.
"You haven't eaten yet, I brought you some delicious food."
Wang Lin put a plastic bag on the table. After untying it, a scent of aroma filled her nostrils.
Ye Kai was really hungry, so he was rude.
He took out a plate and poured the vegetables in the plastic bag onto the plate.
There are braised beef and pork ribs, both hard dishes, a big plate full.
"How's it going? Is it delicious? I saved it just for you."
"Yeah, not bad."
Ye Kai took a pair of chopsticks, picked up a rib and put it into his mouth.
"Don't worry, I have some good stuff here!"
Wang Lin put her hand into her white shirt and found a bulging bag.
Ye Kai quickly waved his hand, "No, no, no, what are you doing?"
Wang Lin chuckled, took her hand out of her shirt, and like magic, took out two big steamed buns and handed them to Ye Kai.
"I know you like to eat steamed buns, so I brought two big steamed buns specially for you."
Ye Kai put his hand on his chest, "Oh my god, you scared me, I thought it was something! It turns out to be steamed buns, you don't have to put them in your clothes!"
"I'm not afraid that it won't taste good if it gets cold."
Ye Kai took the steamed bun, it was indeed soft and warm.
"Thank you, you are really thoughtful."
"Now that you know what's mine, eat it while it's hot."
Ye Kai quickly wiped out the two steamed buns and a plate of food.
Wang Lin sat across from him and watched him eat, nodding her head in praise from time to time. The young man must be able to do so well if he could eat.
After Ye Kai finished eating, he stood up and said, "Let's go, I'll take you home."
"No, I'm not going home."
"How can you, a girl, not go home?"
"I want to live in your house."
"No, we just met. How can we live together when we are alone?"
"I want to live here. I see that your house has two bedrooms. We can share one room each."
"Does your sister know that you came to my house?"
"She doesn't know."
"Your sister will be worried about you and may come looking for you soon. You'd better go back quickly."
